title: Reclamation pass re-reads live, unexpired claims' roots every 30 s; key the canonical re-read cooldown to the claim's expires_at
outcome: Reclamation pass re-reads live, unexpired claims' roots every 30 s; key the canonical re-read cooldown to the claim's expires_at
acceptance: After a canonical read shows a root's claim active and unexpired, the automatic pass does not read that root again before the claim's expires_at (bounded below by the existing cooldown), unless a local event (a naming, a release, a binding change, a refused claim) makes it due sooner; a test shows a live claim's root read once across several passes, then again after its expiry

Roots with closed, lapsed or refused claims keep their existing retirement behaviour and timing; the full five-stage gate passes with an independent review pair and no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding
